newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil higher on export talk, meal mixed.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil higher on export talk, meal mixed.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures were sharply higher early Monday, boosted by talk of activity in export markets and solid gains in soybeans, traders said.
There was widespread talk that a commerical firm bought as much as 60,000 tonnes of vegetable oil from South America late last week for shipment to Iran or China, traders said.
Nearby soymeal futures were under pressure soyoil/soymeal spread trades and sluggish demand in domestic and export markets, floor traders said.
At 1009 CDT, soyoil futures were 0.13 to 0.27 cent per lb higher, with July up 0.15 at $24.96.
Soymeal futures were $1.50 $1.00 per ton lower, withg July down $0.50 at $273.00.
